Low | Speed | booking: machine_id | A link has no index | Joins over these links and deletes of the linked rows get slow as the table grows. | Add an index on machine_id.
Medium | Duplicates | machine.serial_no | Identifier can be duplicated | serial_no is the kind of value that should identify one record, but the database allows the same value twice. | Check for duplicates, then add a unique rule on serial_no.
Medium | Links | machine_function.machine_id | Looks like a link, but nothing checks it | machine_id seems to hold the ID of another record, but there is no rule (foreign key). It can point to records that do not exist. | Count values with no matching record. If the link is real, add a foreign key.
Low | Speed | run: operator_id | A link has no index | Joins over these links and deletes of the linked rows get slow as the table grows. | Add an index on operator_id.
Medium | Consistency | run: settings_xml, settings_json | Same data saved in several formats | The same information is saved 2 times in different formats. If the copies disagree, nobody knows which one is right. | Decide which format is the master copy and compare the others with it before migrating.
Medium | Links | station_nr in booking, run | Shared code with no lookup list | station_nr appears in 2 tables as a plain number. There is no table that lists the allowed values, so wrong or empty values are possible. | Create a small lookup table of valid station_nr values and link to it.
